keyLimits.en: Single-user license for 3D garment simulation and pattern making

cautions.en: Exact current pricing could not be confirmed directly from clo3d.com's own pricing page, which did not return content; figures are sourced from a third-party listing and should be reverified against the official site.

capabilities.en: 3D garment simulation with realistic fabric physics for fashion design and prototyping.
2D pattern making linked live to the 3D simulated garment.
Digital sample and collection visualization intended to reduce physical sampling.

limitations.en: Steep learning curve for pattern-making features, aimed at users with garment construction knowledge.
Full-scene rendering and large collections can be resource-intensive, requiring a capable workstation.

reason.en: 3D content creation tool used for texturing/material work that can complement or substitute parts of a 3D fashion pipeline.
General 3D modeling/sculpting tool sometimes used as an alternative for garment and character asset creation.
